# Beta115 — room controls, mold measurement guidance and cover discovery

## Room dashboard

- Remove the leading home icon from every room overview. The settings button
  remains directly beside the occupancy-coloured room name.
- Press a room warning or information button again to dismiss its details.
  The card restores sections opened by that button and preserves rooms and
  devices that were already expanded. Pointer, keyboard, Escape and live
  controller-status updates retain the correct explanation and focus.
- Unconfigured mold indicators now show the current indoor and outdoor
  temperatures, their signed difference, and whether the temperature contrast
  is suitable for finding the coldest interior surface.

The mold guidance uses a practical **10°C warmer indoors** target. This is a
measurement guideline, separate from the existing numerical calibration guard.
It does not claim that heating, weather or surface conditions have stabilized.
The card explains the need for stable conditions and simultaneous surface,
indoor and outdoor measurements. Missing or stale selected sources cannot
produce a suitable indication; warmer outdoor conditions recommend waiting.

Sources: [Home Assistant calibration instructions](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mold_indicator/#calibration)
and [RICS building thermography guidance](https://ww3.rics.org/uk/en/journals/built-environment-journal/conducting-a-successful-thermographic-survey.html).

## Sensors and room setup

- Explain illuminance use in configuration: a cover's enabled lux condition
  uses its chosen same-room sensor or selected room mean and minimum brightness
  before a new automatic close. Illuminance also supplies light history.
- Remove unused pressure inputs from HEM setup, active room readings and source
  summaries. Existing Home Assistant entities remain intact. Old saved pressure
  metadata remains inert, and unavailable pollutant sources still count as
  incomplete evidence.
- Preselect eligible covers assigned to the room when its cover selection has
  never been saved. Classless native covers with CLOSE support are included,
  even when their startup state is unknown.
- Preserve saved empty and partial cover selections. **Select detected covers**
  in the card's room settings adds the currently offered covers to the draft;
  only Save applies the selection. Cover selection itself grants no movement.

## Validation and update

Regression checks cover the supplied six cover examples, room assignments,
saved selections, source freshness, pressure retirement, lux behavior, all
configuration catalogs, and browser interaction and layout. The existing
backend, dashboard and canonical ZIP checks remain required before publication.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to load
the bundled card. A manual installation ZIP is attached to the release.
